entities.name: Agnieszka Kozłowska-Rajewicz

entities.summary: Agnieszka Kozłowska-Rajewicz is a Polish politician and biology academic, who served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) during the eighth term from 2014 till 2019 representing Greater Poland. She is a member of the Civic Platform, part of the European People's Party.
